method_card.title: School Life, Rules and Issues
method_card.content:
This lesson covers school facilities, rules, uniform and school issues including bullying and exam stress.

FrenchEnglish
la bibliothèquelibrary
la cantinecanteen
la cour (de récréation)playground / courtyard
la salle de classeclassroom
le terrain de sportsports field
le gymnasegym
on doityou must / we must
il est interdit deit is forbidden to
on ne peut pasyou cannot
l'uniformeuniform
le harcèlementbullying
le stressstress
la pressionpressure
réussirto succeed / to pass
échouerto fail
le brevet (Higher)GCSE-equivalent qualification

Expressing rules: Three key structures: Il faut + infinitive = you must; On doit + infinitive = you must; Il est interdit de + infinitive = it is forbidden to. After a negative, the indefinite/partitive article becomes de: il n'y a pas de piscine.

School issues: Le harcèlement = bullying; le stress des examens = exam stress; la pression = pressure. Use à cause de (because of) or à mon avis (in my opinion) to build arguments.

Model: Dans mon collège, il y a une grande bibliothèque et une cantine. On doit porter un uniforme et il est interdit d'utiliser son portable en classe. À mon avis, le harcèlement est un problème sérieux dans beaucoup d'écoles. (In my school, there is a large library and a canteen. You must wear a uniform and it is forbidden to use your phone in class. In my opinion, bullying is a serious problem in many schools.)
steps: Learn school facility vocabulary using il y a and il n'y a pas de
Master three structures for rules: il faut, on doit, il est interdit de
Remember that the article changes to de after il n'y a pas
Learn key vocabulary for school issues: bullying, stress, exam pressure
Practise giving your opinion on school uniform using pour and contre arguments

exam_context.frequency: Popular topic for extended writing and speaking tasks

worked_examples.question: Translate: 'Dans mon collège, il y a une grande bibliothèque.'

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: il y a = there is / there are.

steps.label: Step 3
steps.content: une grande bibliothèque = a large library. Grande agrees with bibliothèque (feminine).

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: In my school, there is a large library.

worked_examples.question: What happens to the article after 'il n'y a pas'?

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: In a positive sentence: il y a une piscine (there is a swimming pool).

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: After il n'y a pas, the article changes to de: il n'y a pas de piscine.

steps.label: Step 3
steps.content: Before a vowel, de becomes d': il n'y a pas d'infirmerie (there is no medical room).

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: After il n'y a pas, the article always changes to de (or d' before a vowel), regardless of gender.

bronze.question: Match the French school facilities to the English meaning
Match the French clothing vocabulary to the English meaning
Complete the sentence about school rules

gaps.correct_explain: doit = must. On doit porter un uniforme = You must wear a uniform.

wrong.peut: peut = can. The sentence means 'must', not 'can'. Use doit.

gaps.correct_explain: interdit = forbidden. Il est interdit de manger en classe = It is forbidden to eat in class.

bronze.question: Complete the facility description
sentence_parts: une grande bibliothèque. Cependant, il n'y a pas

gaps.correct_explain: y a — il y a = there is / there are.
After il n'y a pas, the article changes to de: il n'y a pas de piscine.

wrong.une: After il n'y a pas, une changes to de: il n'y a pas de piscine.

bronze.question: What does 'Il est interdit d'utiliser son portable pendant les leçons' mean?
options: It is forbidden to use your phone during lessons
It is allowed to use your phone during lessons
You must use your phone during lessons
You can use your phone after lessons

bronze.question: Which is an argument FOR school uniform?
options: L'uniforme est moins cher que les autres vêtements
L'uniforme n'est pas à la mode
On ne peut pas montrer sa personnalité

bronze.source_text: On doit porter un uniforme. L'uniforme est moins cher que les autres vêtements.
model_answers: You must wear a uniform. The uniform is cheaper than other clothes.

silver.question: Complete the sentence by typing the correct word
silver.english: You cannot show your personality with a uniform.

gaps.correct_explain: peut is the on form of pouvoir. On ne peut pas = you cannot.

wrong.peux: peux is the je/tu form. For on, use peut.

gaps.correct_explain: personnalité = personality. Montrer sa personnalité = to show your personality.

silver.question: Find and fix the grammatical error
silver.sentence: Il n'y a pas un terrain de sport dans mon collège.
silver.explanation: After il n'y a pas, the article must change to de: il n'y a pas de terrain de sport.
silver.translation: There is no sports field in my school.

silver.question: Build the sentence in French
silver.english: It is forbidden to eat sweets in class.

distractor_labels.les: wrong article — use des (partitive) for unspecified sweets in a general statement

model_answers: Dans mon collège, les règles sont assez strictes. On doit porter un uniforme et il est interdit d'utiliser son portable.

gold.question: Role Play
gold.scenario: A French student is visiting your town. You meet at the leisure centre and they ask you about school life in the UK.

bullets.prompt: Describe what facilities your school has (give two examples).
bullets.model_answer: Dans mon collège, il y a une grande bibliothèque et une cantine moderne. Cependant, il n'y a pas de piscine.
bullets.note: il y a + facility; il n'y a pas de + facility (de replaces un/une after negative)

bullets.prompt: Explain two rules at your school.
bullets.model_answer: On doit porter un uniforme et il est interdit d'utiliser son portable en classe.
bullets.note: on doit + infinitive; il est interdit de / d' + infinitive

bullets.prompt: Give your opinion on school uniform — one argument for, one against.
bullets.model_answer: L'uniforme est moins cher, mais on ne peut pas montrer sa personnalité. Personnellement, je préférerais porter mes propres vêtements.
bullets.note: comparative moins cher; on ne peut pas; conditional préférerais for opinion
